searchText: RE merging consensus and execution calls: The last 2 weeks' worth of calls show IMO that the topics do not intersect enough thus the separation of layers should remain And at the same time the IL EIP would have benefited from having the 3074 crowd early on. Honestly many of us are on both calls anyway and anyone that doesn't want to be when it's Cl or El heavy can simply look at the topics beforehand I still feel pretty strongly there's value in keeping a default "theme" for each call, while being flexible with urgent topics 🙂 And given the past few calls have all bumped into the 90m mark, I don't think now is the time where we should have less of them 😅 But I do feel like over, say, the past year, the number of calls + breakouts has grown quite a lot and we should find a better way to "manage" this. This sounds to me compatible with both approaches. Curating carefully the list of topics for the meeting before hand may attract more EL devs one day and more CL devs another. The interleaved cadence for these is what seems artificial to me But then would me and Danny have to start working full time? Decision making should really be made async, by voting, blog posts (intentions) or github md matrix (any kind would work). Call should be there for presentations, discussions, announcements, summaries etc. <mikeneuder> > <mikeneuder> LOL (re @allcoredevs_bot: <timbeiko> But then would me and Danny have to start working full time?) I think we should do a better job of async discussion and temperature checks, we should avoid formal voting Decision making 🧵
